welcome:
🎬 Welcome to MovieRando CLI! 

 Discover movies and shows effortlessly.
Type 'get-started' to see how to begin.
Type 'help' for a full list of commands.
getStarted:
Try these commands:

- Random movie/show: mr -random
- Search movie/show by name: mr -search -name=Inception
- Search by genre: mr -search -genre=action
- Search by year: mr -search -year=2010
- Combine flags: mr -search -name=Inception -genre=action -year=2010
help:
Available commands:

mr -random          Fetch a random movie or show
mr -search          Search movies/shows with flags
  Flags:
    -name           Search by name
    -genre          Filter by genre
    -year           Filter by year
    -minRating      Minimum rating (0-10)
    -language       Language (ISO code, e.g., en)
    -type           Type: movie or tv
clear               Clear the terminal
get-started         Show how to get started quickly
help                Show this help message
